title: PJM utility large-load submission history
purpose: Catalog public PJM Load Analysis Subcommittee large-load adjustment and data-center load submission materials outside the generation interconnection queue.
accounting: Document/evidence records, not unique facilities. Presence of a submission does not establish a facility, customer MW or queue ID unless separately evidenced.
